title: FLIMSY AND NOT VERY STURDY
text: FLIMSY AND NOT VERY STURDY. I USED THIS ONCE RIGHT AFTER I GOT IT AND I DONT CARE FOR IT. IT IS POOR PUT TOGETHER, IT IS FLIMSY, AND NOT VERY STURDY WHEN LAID DOWN FLAT (WOBBLES). I SHOULD HAVE SPENT THE EXTRA MONEY AND GOT SOMETHING A BIT BIGGER WITH BETTER QUALITY. THANKS.

product_metadata.title: Electric Panini Press, Aigostar 4-6 Slices Temperature Control Sandwich Maker, Panini Press Grill with Removable Drip Tray, Opens 180 Degrees Non-Stick Coated Plates, 11.6" X 9.3"
features: 🔥4 Slice Large Panini Press Grill - 2 large 11.6" x 9.3" cooking plates, can provide panini bread, burgers, savory sandwiches for 4-6 people at one time, opens 180 degrees and floating hinge adapted for any angle of grilling, steaks, veggitables, quesadillas, sweet fruit turnovers and other grilling foods.

🔥Dual-Plate Fast & Even Heating - 1400W high power output, equipped with uniform heating technology, electric panini press grill only takes 5 mininues to reach the approprite temperature, which allows you to cook berakfast in a few minutes. Additionally, this indoor grill can function as a panini press, sandwich maker, countertop steak grill and roaster machine.

🔥Teamperture Control - The temperature of indoor grill can be adjusted(374-446°F) by rotating the Knob. The panini grill can provide precise and consistent heat, which ensures that the sandwich is evenly cooked and perfectly toasted. With temperature control, you can adjust the temperature to achieve the desired level of crispiness and browning, making it possible to achieve the perfect panini every time. An excellent choice for anyone who loves delicious and perfectly cooked paninis.

🔥LED Indicator - There are red and green indicator lights to show the working process, red light is power indicator, green light is ready indicator, so electric panini press makes it easy to keep the good color, smell and taste of food, just don't worry about the food is over burned.

🔥Easy to Clean & Non-Stick Coating - The surface of the baking tray is non-stick coating, you can use a soft cloth to remove the food residue easily, and this non-stick coating can effectively reduce oily smoke when grilling, there are a removable drip tray under the press grill, it's convenient to remove it to clean the oily.

🔥Safety Panini Press for Cooking - This panini press sandwich maker comes with handle lock and anti-slip feet to ensure the stability on grilling, and cool-touch handle makes it more safer during cooking, the cable can be stowed and easily stored. if you have any question about our product, please contact us, we will try our best to help you and give you the best solution.

🔥Versatility Panini Machine - Aigostar panini sandwich press are versatile and can be used to make a variety of different sandwiches and dishes. You can experiment with different breads, cheeses, meats, and vegetables to create your own unique Panini creations.

🔥An Healthier Option - Paninis can be a healthier option than traditional sandwiches because they don't require as much butter or oil to be cooked. You can also use healthier bread options, such as whole-grain or gluten-free, and incorporate more vegetables into your Panini fillings.
🔥A Great Press Sandwich Maker - offers a more convenient, efficient, and healthy way to prepare tasty sandwiches at home or in a commercial kitchen.
❤️Satisfied Customer Service - If there has any problem with your panini press, please feel free to send us a message for a solution.
